@graph.description:
Replication of nav2's spin-behavior system test
(nav2_system_tests/src/behaviors/spin, main). Where upstream drives the /spin
action with a Python tester (spin_tester.py) against a tb3 Gazebo world, this
campaign runs the full nav2 stack (files/nav2_stack.launch.py, the same hexagon
world as the sibling behaviors_wait, error_codes and system_failure campaigns)
and drives /spin with the generic action_call primitive.

MEANING OF A CELL: one configuration is one upstream spin parameterization
(nav2_system_tests.csv lines 19-22, test case `test_spin_behavior`). The spin
behavior SUCCEEDS after reaching the target yaw for the valid-costmap case, and
ABORTS for the costmap-dependent and impossible-command cases. The valid-costmap
cell carries expect_success: true; the invalid-costmap, impossible-command and
lethal-costmap cells carry expect_success: false. The analysis additionally
verifies the upstream `error_code == 0` assertion on success and the specific
error_code on abort from the recorded /spin/_action timestamps (not expressible
in the scenario; see spin_behavior.osc header).

PORTED CASE -> GOAL:
- Invalid costmap  (CSV line 19) -> target_yaw 20 deg, time_allowance 5 s
- Valid costmap    (CSV line 20) -> target_yaw 20 deg, time_allowance 5 s
- Impossible command (CSV line 21) -> target_yaw 20 deg, time_allowance 0.1 s
- Lethal costmap   (CSV line 22) -> target_yaw 20 deg, time_allowance 5 s

NOT PORTED: the preempt-and-invert and cancel sub-cases inside the upstream
valid-costmap test, and the manual costmap publishing used to trigger
costmap-dependent failures. A mid-run preempt or cancel cannot be sequenced in
this scenario framework (action_call has no preempt or cancel entry point --
RosActionCall.shutdown() cancels only at scenario teardown), and the framework
has no mechanism to publish arbitrary costmaps to /local_costmap/costmap_raw
before sending the goal. Recorded, not faked, in readme.md.

UPSTREAM ODDITY worth recording: upstream CMakeLists.txt sets
BT_NAVIGATOR_XML=navigate_to_pose_w_replanning_and_behavior.xml, a file that exists
neither in the navigation2 source tree nor in the installed nav2_bt_navigator share
directory (verified in the robovast image). It is immaterial here -- /spin is a
behavior-server action, not a BT node -- but the CSV row's BT column therefore names
a file that cannot be loaded.
